:::{.proof}
We verify symmetry and idempotency.

**Symmetry:**
$$
\begin{aligned}
\tp{(\matr{I} - \matr{P})}
&= \tp{\matr{I}} - \tp{\matr{P}} \\
&= \matr{I} - \matr{P}
\end{aligned}
$$

**Idempotency:**
$$\ba
(\matr{I} - \matr{P})^2
&= (\matr{I} - \matr{P})(\matr{I} - \matr{P}) \\
&= \matr{I} - \matr{P} - \matr{P} + \matr{P}^2 \\
&= \matr{I} - \matr{P} - \matr{P} + \matr{P} \\
&= \matr{I} - \matr{P}
\ea$$
:::
